extracted.intended_audience: general readers and historians of 19th-century exploration/travel narratives
extracted.subtask_description: First-person/third-person narrative account of an overland exploration journey in 19th-century Australia, describing day-by-day camps, hardships, natural features, encounters with indigenous people, and logistical improvisations. Useful as a primary-source travelogue rather than a how-to or style guide.
